messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver King <oliver.king@sigma-bio.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Export-control / sanctions exception + commercial terms for SigmaBio pilot

Team — looping you on a time-sensitive commercial exception request. Customer: SigmaBio LLC (contact: Oliver King). Summary: they want a 6-week pilot to validate our private deployment for clinical note redaction. ARR potential ~ $1.2M/yr if pilot converts.

Why this is flagged:
- Their parent / UBO screening shows an indirect ownership link to a firm with registration in a jurisdiction on our sanctions watchlist (flag in UBO screening attached).
- Standard policy would block providing hosted inference or any export-controlled software that could be routed/used from that jurisdiction.

What the customer is proposing:
- Pilot to run in Redwood Private (customer VPC) in Singapore region only.
- Restrict model to a small open-source model (no LLM weights export).
- Contractual warranty that no operations will be from the sanctioned jurisdiction; payment can be routed via Singapore entity.
- Asking for a 20% one-time pilot credit and a non-standard clause to limit our indemnity for downstream patient-data claims.

Attachments: SigmaBio_KYC_summary.pdf, UBO_screening.csv (details on ownership chain).

Decision requested:
1) Exec-level approval to proceed with an export-control / sanctions exception to allow Private-only deployment for this customer (pilot only) subject to mitigations below.
2) Approval for one-time 20% credit (sales) and permission to accept the proposed non-standard indemnity cap for pilot (legal).

Proposed mitigations (to offset risk):
- Legal to require explicit UBO declaration + attestation plus final PEP/sanctions check within 72 hours.
- Security to require: data residency enforcement (Singapore only), network egress disabled, enforced logging and read-only access for Redwood staff, and quarterly audits.
- Commercial: pilot credit contingent on signed DocuSign with revised SOW that includes the mitigations and an elevated security audit schedule.

Timeline: customer wants to start week of 6/15. Need an exec decision by end of day Monday 6/8 to hit that date.

Oliver — I copied internal legal and deal desk. Please confirm you can provide the corporate registry and an UBO declaration by Monday.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0119

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Export-control / sanctions exception + commercial terms for SigmaBio pilot

Vivek — thanks for the clear summary and the prompt. A few immediate legal points:

1) Policy baseline: if any UBO/controlling interest is in a sanctioned jurisdiction, we generally decline providing software (hosted or otherwise) that could be considered an export. Private-only deployment reduces some risk but does not remove it if beneficial ownership or control can flow from the sanctioned entity.

2) Required documentation before any exception considered:
   - Certified corporate registry for the contracting legal entity.
   - UBO declaration signed by an officer (template available on request).
   - Recent (within 30 days) third-party sanctions & PEP screening report for each UBO (we need source evidence).

3) Contractual language: I won't approve any indemnity cap or non-standard liability language for pilot without the above docs and a sanctioned-jurisdiction escape clause. Any deviation must be approved at the executive legal level (GC / CEO sign-off).

4) Suggested path: if they can provide the docs by Monday we can run an expedited review. If the UBO screening still shows a material risk, Legal will likely request either (a) route of payment strictly via a clean Singapore entity + warranty + audit right, or (b) decline.

Markus — please provide the economics impact (net new ARR, churn risk, references) so Legal can weigh strategic vs. compliance risk.

Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

- Risk: reputational + regulatory if ownership link proves material.

I support an exception limited to: Private-only deployment, reduced model capability, full audit access, and escrowed additional insurance. If Legal insists on GC/CEO sign-off for liability changes, please escalate to Dan/CEO.

If we do not make an exception, the customer is likely to evaluate alternative providers — we could lose the account.

1) We will grant a provisional, time-limited approval to proceed with Private-only pilot provided the following are received and verified by Legal & Trust within 72 hours: certified corporate registry, signed UBO attestation, and official third-party sanctions/PEP screening reports.

2) Commercial concession: deal desk will approve a 15% pilot credit (not 20%), conditioned on DocuSign SOW with the mitigations Vivek outlined. Any indemnity/limitation changes require explicit sign-off by the GC (Rachel) and an executive (CEO/CRO).
